notes: v1.7.0 — Password-less admin sign-in with GitHub OAuth: free, no credit card, no Zero Trust plan. Create a GitHub OAuth App, set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET / GITHUB_ADMIN_IDS on your Worker (step-by-step guide in Settings → Admin access & sign-in), and the admin login shows "Sign in with GitHub". The token is used once and discarded; the password stays as a fallback.
